statement: Exact actual positive-product profile theorem. With u_-(P_A)=min A in the natural real order and Pi_j=(u_-(F_j),u_-(F_0),u_-(P_Aj),u_-(P_A0)), every exact common-spectrum leaf satisfies Pi_j=(phi_j,phi_0,v-phi_j,alpha_0), where phi_j=min(lambda_j X). Thus Pi and phi have exactly identical ranges and fibres, while the residual delta_j=alpha_j+phi_j-v is identically zero. On a same-sign class of distinct scalars, phi_j=lambda_j min(X) for positive scalars and phi_j=lambda_j max(X) for negative scalars. Hence the literal profile range is exactly one when the relevant endpoint is zero and is injective otherwise; on the selected power-large class the latter range is |J_sigma|>=K/2=t^(5/9-o(1)).
